title: Lab 5 — HA Overview and etcd Backup/Restore
description: Review HA topology and quorum, then back up etcd and restore it: create a Deployment, Service and ConfigMap, snapshot etcd, delete the namespace, and bring everything back.

steps.title: Step 1: Topology, quorum, and what makes a cluster HA-ready
Step 2: Find etcd's endpoint, certificates and data directory
Step 3: Create the state you are going to lose
Step 4: Take and verify the snapshot
Step 6: Restore, and get it all back
